# Scientific American

> > Scientific American (SciAm) is a leading science journalism publication covering research, discoveries, and innovations across all scientific disciplines, published by Springer Nature America, Inc.

The site offers digital and print subscriptions to its flagship magazine, multimedia content including documentary series like "The Protectors" focused on wildlife conservation, and serves as a comprehensive resource for science news and analysis. Available on iOS, Android, and web platforms.
